claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_destruction_last_charge_outcomes
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing destruction policy can only model destruction or permanent exhaustion, not a last-charge roll that conditionally strips some properties or restores charges.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains 1d8 + 2 charges.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: linked_resource_remaining_amount
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Retributive Strike reads the staff's current remaining charge pool to set damage; the current surface only supports fixed amounts, level scaling, resource spent, or linked damage, not remaining charges in a pool.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff. Each other creature in the area ... takes Force damage equal to 4 times the number of charges in the staff.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: area_excludes_self
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The area save applies to every other creature in the emanation while the wielder is handled separately by the 50 percent avoidance branch. Current area attachments do not express that exclusion honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each other creature in the area makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw.
